Results › Cell 101

Cell 101: dmin list, coded

The sorted list of dmin(n), split into residue classes modulo 2310. Each class is stored by binary interpolative coding. Each n follows from dmin(n) once dmin(n) is factored.

Switches: A on, B off, C on. What the switches mean.

Times

Build, oracle to file
159.1 min on one thread: 158.0 min for the dmin list and 1.2 min for encoding.
Decode, CNs only
215.1 min. The list itself decodes in 0.61 min, and the rest is factoring every dmin.
Decode, CNs + primes
224.0 min
Certify against the oracle
22.5 min on 13 threads

Times are on an Intel Core i9-9900K (8 cores, 16 threads), 64 GB RAM, NVMe SSD, Windows 10. Decode times are in memory. The notes under the results table say how each time is measured.

Build

Rebuild the file from the oracle with:

make fetch-oracle rebuild-101

The target first builds the dmin list (see intermediate files), then runs the encoder:

dlist_from_paths --orc1 data/carmichael-1e24-oracle.orc1 work/d.raw --threads N
list_build classes work/d.raw work/carmichael-1e24-cell101-dmin-classes.cnd --mod 2310 --targets-orc1 data/carmichael-1e24-oracle.orc1

Verify, decode and certify

make fetch-101 verify-101
make fetch-oracle certify-101

Verify first checks the size and SHA-256 of the file. Then the targets run these commands:

# make verify-101
list_decode data/carmichael-1e24-cell101-dmin-classes.cnd
# make certify-101
cnd_decode data/carmichael-1e24-cell101-dmin-classes.cnd --certify data/carmichael-1e24-oracle.orc1 --threads N
list_decode data/carmichael-1e24-cell101-dmin-classes.cnd --kind d --certify data/carmichael-1e24-oracle.orc1 --threads N    # with CERTIFY_TOOL=list_decode
# make decode-101
list_decode data/carmichael-1e24-cell101-dmin-classes.cnd --emit work/c101.values.raw --kind d --emit-n work/c101.n.raw --threads N

N is the number of threads. The reproduce page explains the folders and the defaults.
